extracted_content.title: PURPOSE
extracted_content.content: Rural Health Clinics (RHCs) are outpatient facilities that provide primary and preventive

extracted_content.title: PURPOSE
extracted_content.content: health care services to populations that live in more remote areas. This policy explains how

extracted_content.title: PURPOSE
extracted_content.content: we cover and pay for these services.

extracted_content.title: APPLICABILITY
extracted_content.content: This policy applies to all Devoted Health plans.

extracted_content.title: POLICY
extracted_content.content: When you see one of our members at your RHC, we cover:

extracted_content.title: POLICY
extracted_content.content: ○ High Intensity Behavioral Counseling to Prevent Sexually Transmitted

extracted_content.title: POLICY
extracted_content.content: ○ Intense Behavioral Therapy for Cardiovascular Disease

extracted_content.title: POLICY
extracted_content.content: When our member is seen by multiple practitioners on the same day, we generally consider it

extracted_content.title: POLICY
extracted_content.content: one payable encounter. For example, if they see their optometrist for an eye exam and then

extracted_content.title: POLICY
extracted_content.content: see their PCP for an office visit, itʼs one payable encounter. However, if our member has been

extracted_content.title: POLICY
extracted_content.content: discharged and they return later that day for a new acute medical issue, we consider this a

extracted_content.title: POLICY
extracted_content.content: separately payable encounter. Mental health services provided on the same day as medical

extracted_content.title: POLICY
extracted_content.content: services are covered as a separate encounter but are subject to the same limitations.

extracted_content.title: POLICY
extracted_content.content: Ambulance rides, durable medical equipment, laboratory services, and vaccines

extracted_content.title: POLICY
extracted_content.content: and their administration are considered non-RHC services but are covered under

extracted_content.title: HOW TO BILL YOUR CLAIMS
extracted_content.content: We reimburse claims according to the Medicare AIR payment rules except for items paid

extracted_content.title: HOW TO BILL YOUR CLAIMS
extracted_content.content: by cost report. Reimbursement is global for all services provided on the same day, except

extracted_content.title: HOW TO BILL YOUR CLAIMS
extracted_content.content: as noted in this section. Please refer to your contract for specific reimbursement details.

extracted_content.title: HOW TO BILL YOUR CLAIMS
extracted_content.content: Please note: To ensure the correct application of member cost-share, you must include

extracted_content.title: HOW TO BILL YOUR CLAIMS
extracted_content.content: a CPT®/HCPCS code for each service provided, even if theyʼre not considered separately

extracted_content.title: HOW TO BILL YOUR CLAIMS
extracted_content.content: RHC services payable under the AIR need to be billed on a CMS-1450 (UB-04) or X12 837I

extracted_content.content: Effective for dates of service on or after 1/1/26, all behavioral health claims must be billed

extracted_content.title: HOW TO BILL YOUR CLAIMS
extracted_content.content: directly to us. For 2025 dates of service, providers who were solely contracted with Magellan

extracted_content.title: HOW TO BILL YOUR CLAIMS
extracted_content.content: on the date of service and not contracted with our plan should continue to bill Magellan.

extracted_content.title: HOW TO BILL YOUR CLAIMS
extracted_content.content: Medical and behavioral health claims must still be billed separately, even when services are

extracted_content.title: HOW TO BILL YOUR CLAIMS
extracted_content.content: rendered on the same date of service.

extracted_content.title: HOW TO BILL YOUR CLAIMS
extracted_content.content: Preventive services provided on the same date of service as another visit are not separately

extracted_content.title: HOW TO BILL YOUR CLAIMS
extracted_content.content: payable , except for annual physicals billed with CPT® code range 99385-99387 for new

extracted_content.title: HOW TO BILL YOUR CLAIMS
extracted_content.content: patients and CPT® code range 99395-99397 for established patients as well as the vaccines

extracted_content.title: HOW TO BILL YOUR CLAIMS
extracted_content.content: addressed in the section below. These should be submitted as two separate claims to ensure

extracted_content.title: HOW TO BILL YOUR CLAIMS
extracted_content.content: Separate and distinct medical encounters on the same date of service need to be

extracted_content.title: HOW TO BILL YOUR CLAIMS
extracted_content.content: submitted on a separate claim and include modifier 59 on the second visit.
